show_subtitle: Jocko Willink's leadership principles, one at a time — through faith, the National Guard, the trade, and home.
show_description: A short daily study working through the 12 principles of Extreme Ownership by Jocko Willink and Leif Babin. Each pass through the book applies the principles through a different lens: as a disciple of Jesus Christ, as a Warrant Officer and engineer in the Army National Guard, as an electrical contractor running his own business, and as a husband and father. New episodes weekdays.
